title: finding(components): an `action:bar` inline action authored with `component: 'action:menu'` or `'action:group'` renders nothing — the action vanishes from the toolbar and a `?runAction=` deep link to it runs nothing
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. The sites: `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-bar.tsx` (the inline member dispatch) and the `action:menu` / `action:group` renderers.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10274 (PR objectui#10342). The dev measured it; ⛔ it is filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

`action:bar` renders each inline action with the renderer its `component` names (`action.component || 'action:button'`, then `ComponentRegistry.get`), and spreads the single action onto that renderer's schema. The spec's `ActionSchema.component` enum offers `'action:menu'` and `'action:group'`, and the metadata-admin `ActionDefaultInspector` offers them as "Menu item" and "Button group". Both renderers read `schema.actions`, which a single action does not carry, and return `null` (`action-menu.tsx`: `if (actions.length === 0) return null;`). So:

- the action **disappears from the toolbar** with no error and no author diagnostic;
- a `?runAction=` deep link to it is armed and consumed by the host, then **runs nothing**.

## Reproduction (the dev's probe at PR head `3b6341b`, not committed)

The setup is one `action:bar` with an unflagged control action plus one member flagged `autoTrigger`, with the member's `component` varied:

| member `component` | executions | buttons rendered |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `action:button` | 1 | Control, Member |
| `action:icon` (after PR objectui#10342) | 1 | Control, Member |
| `action:menu` | 0 | Control |
| `action:group` | 0 | Control |

⚠️ These readings are the dev's, relayed by the seat, ⛔ not re-run by the seat.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- Authorable today through a spec enum member and a designer option, and the failure is silent.
- The fix direction is open. The bar could render a single-action member of these kinds as a button; the spec could refuse `component: 'action:menu' | 'action:group'` on a single action; or the renderers could accept a single action. That may be a small decision.

Seam: `spec:ActionSchema.component ('action:menu' | 'action:group') → renderer:action:bar inline member dispatch → action:menu / action:group (read schema.actions, absent on a single action ⇒ null)`

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, pattern `(action:menu|action:group) … (inline|member|bar) … (null|nothing|vanish|renders no)` / `action:bar … component … (menu|group)` ⇒ 0 hits. Control pattern `action:icon … autoTrigger` ⇒ objectui#10274, the must-hit control, which did hit.

Dedupe words: `component action:menu bar member renders nothing` · `action:group inline member vanishes` · `action:bar component override` · `autoTrigger menu member`
